run_confusion_matrix_cli: run the confusion matrix tool from detection results pkl file with a config and save directory
calculate_confusion_matrix: calculate the confusion matrix from a dataset and detection results with configurable score and IoU thresholds
analyze_per_img_dets: analyze per-image detection results against ground truth to update the confusion matrix with TP, FP, FN
plot_confusion_matrix: plot a normalized confusion matrix heatmap with matplotlib and save or display the figure
parse_args: parse command line arguments for the confusion matrix tool including config, prediction path, and thresholds
